title: Community Comments
text:
## Community Comments
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000075521

## This is a Free Add-On and Enabled on All Websites

## Overview
With the Community Comments Add-On, enable comments on all of the Post Type detail pages by logged - in members.
Add native comment functionality to the website. Logged-in, active members will be able to leave comments on the website’s content and reply to other members’ comments.
This website add-on eliminates the need to use a third-party solution, such as Disqus, and provides a seamless user experience.

## Enabling the Add-On
Go to Interactions » Post Comments
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175508352/original/4mwepHb3N3Vxsy3HdDqiR6PL8m-p3OMShg.png?1772639409 | alt: ]
In the next page click on "Comment Settings" :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175508412/original/Wq4kL5D2GmEfrB4Cxgr3e1Bkq1tnnZs00g.png?1772639460 | alt: ]
Within Comment Settings, select " Yes " to enable the functionality:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12131526798/original/u8tzQNUinaodY5pOqOmpmLK_M14JHtT1WQ.png?1695129174 | alt: ]
Select the post types that will allow comments, keep in mind it's possible to filter by keyword:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12131527483/original/tMu3XpAchOjBW2U7Xq7RXqYpmmmz-uIRKw.png?1695129783 | alt: ]
Add the Default Title Text for Comments Section and the Maximum Character Limit of Each Comment (1000 characters is the maximum limit):
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12131527660/original/FKM-YcLQN427JkXb9UTyFvCtGPL-FPvOFA.png?1695129960 | alt: ]
After selecting the post types that allow comments,  a list of settings will appear to configure the functionality per post type, click on each tab to review them:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12131528320/original/SiDEuvOE7Rlcd6m3Bd1UV6REOXVQIHS9jQ.png?1695130480 | alt: ]

## In-Depth Look at the Post Comment Settings
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175508626/original/x2XqmFks9QTo0qz5DsVoYit-70TGfTrnyg.png?1772639621 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175746402/original/hbE1FMRC5N7KBP24TzpgenmsrpgD4J-nEQ.png?1773095397 | alt: ]

## 1. Use an alternate title for this Comment Section
This option allows admins to use a different title per post type, instead of the default one. This is what the title will look like:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105392961/original/9Q5JdrMXclU69sKpJpezfsSQDBcs_0t6pg.png?1645500447 | alt: ]

## 2. Moderate Comments Before Being Published
These comments can be approved/declined in the backend Admin dashboard explained in the section below.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105392372/original/oszhOQl1kGfWYMUjXCA1TMPt1chEldhQFg.png?1645498133 | alt: ]
Text Label Variable: comments_pending_approval
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104084023/original/J5LqGYuiDsMcDEiO04FbuXayZ9gSBUajJQ.png?1643054633 | alt: ]

## 3. Display Comments Count In Search Results Pages Yes:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104084457/original/7vEHfW0GU10QNFBMlGqXIUQjBMdvDKX1Pw.png?1643055180 | alt: ]

## 4. Display "Follow Comment" button
This allows users to " Follow Comments ", meaning, if a comment is left on the post, the user will receive a simple email notification linking to the new comment (similar to private chat emails notifications)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144791222/original/ShsazqJZBs61QQGTwL8Fv2xxIxZjW87AMQ.png?1718296636 | alt: ]
The last option " CANCEL " will allow the user to Turn Off notifications after they've already opted to follow the post in the first place.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144792076/original/4bWTlq203K1JsVZyvwgW5EzVu1TIawkvug.png?1718297167 | alt: ]

## 5. Display Comments Count on Post Details Page Yes - Above Post
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105392436/original/u6Pg_-DbL7ZLUavbjOph4kqAfky-UTVcKw.png?1645498467 | alt: ]
Yes - Above Comment Section
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105392401/original/fgH2TBk5RzMkD196ZIQXihpP3Ln1sn54Pw.png?1645498279 | alt: ]
Yes - Above Post and Comment Section
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105392415/original/BCk-9Ymc4M_sn6VfZK_sIstUfmTQwEaNrA.png?1645498368 | alt: ]

## 6. Enable Star Rating with Initial Comment
If enabled, users can select a 1-5 star rating with their initial comment.
For a better explanation, please refer to Star Ratings For Posts

## 7. Allow Users to Edit Their Comments
When enabled the option to edit the comment submitted will be available.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576040/original/176HkTST0DXckwj_ZGv2sAZNrOq9XJiGOA.png?1772732621 | alt: ]
The option to give a Max. Days to Edit the submitted comment is available as well.

## 8. Allow Users to Delete Their Comments
When enabled, the option to delete the comment submitted will be available.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576090/original/ZbB-60LyLU8YKZa0V3sbyUS437u_x1PqBg.png?1772732696 | alt: ]
The option to give a Max. Days to Delete the submitted comment is available as well.

## Showing Member Badges on Post Comments
If the Member Badges Add-on is enabled on the website, the badges will display once a comment is submitted:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105392513/original/3V_H6DJrjPRbw4mUtWdH_NIHSkTX2C0xHA.png?1645498748 | alt: ]

## Filter Post Comments via Keyword Search
Enter any word to filter comments by keyword.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105392794/original/frZgZw6Ct-N99m9fFtLtCk0_4a1xZSwA9Q.gif?1645499862 | alt: ]

## Available Sort Order Options for Comments
Filter by sort options: Oldest First, Newest First, or Most Replies.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105392850/original/Pz4RLtqbXy5qIe4p_xjk-TtDL4ojtLbCFA.png?1645500029 | alt: ]

## Backend/Admin Functionality
There are several filter options available on the backend for comments.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576318/original/MrTVbA-2KCAJhUi6hRQlnEvINLYak7afLg.png?1772732992 | alt: ]

## Bulk Change Status
Bulk Change Status to Accepted, Pending, Declined, and Delete.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576353/original/0_4PmTnT4v7N0JGztjWQa04vZk7mmPtIMQ.png?1772733033 | alt: ]

## Post Type
Comments can be filtered by post type.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576493/original/XP0zYtB-ixXe90M4BCneXUOEEk0jXgDADg.png?1772733172 | alt: ]

## Filter Status
Comments can be filtered by status: Accepted, Pending, or Declined.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576505/original/LHcd5Xwg7Qbpff_BEASCLcacnIM7Xf-1WA.png?1772733208 | alt: ]

## Overall Rating
If the AddOn Star Ratings For Posts is enabled on the website, the filter by overal rating will be available.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576593/original/2qMU9EJ9g2pIxpHLqBRIqztURjaHgrIvaw.png?1772733285 | alt: ]

## Member Name or ID
Comments can be filtered by name or ID.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576657/original/44oi3_Y2xJ760zh62MrImBqMJB5yVl9l8g.png?1772733339 | alt: ]

## Keyword or Post Title
Comments can be filtered by keyword or post title.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576694/original/n-h6-OiKP70OS6aukgwWFS9dpbtTyVILUw.png?1772733411 | alt: ]

## Individual Actions within each Comment
Individual actions can be taken for each submitted comment.

## Actions Drop-down
From here, the comment on the post can be viewed or deleted.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576725/original/G3qTyEltBwu9_ngMXu1n0ubswhZarXK2JQ.png?1772733451 | alt: ]

## Member Information
Information about the member who submitted the comment can be accessed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576762/original/dDMRPczk6-bobA4injsnI6eDvMtRlVxM7Q.png?1772733477 | alt: ]

## Individual Status Change
Individual comments can be changed by status: Accepted, Pending, or Declined.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576797/original/M1wEYaNdiTrdOq-F3MMBhoDWourrA9snbA.png?1772733497 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12084592363/original/If__vqhvaQ6DpVXGFdLo9_VRFAhhy002VA.png?1604607980 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12084592367/original/75U8Yzy9YMOMSDzfUW5_kE31iPPBQqA6Qw.png?1604607985 | alt: ]

## Post Title Link
An option is available to click the link of the post where the comment was submitted.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576828/original/7yrkh6y9sACMdTmWzYGp-vuUJFcve7YnjQ.png?1772733522 | alt: ]
"View All Comments" An option is available to view all the comments submitted from the same post.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576838/original/0CLYQTGZIX30Hiw16Q6hgbBAZssrDca5ZA.png?1772733534 | alt: ]

## Edit the comment
The submitted comment can be edited.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576861/original/VDo-zBDhtzHFEOZGO8sajenq-MTTlH4kRw.png?1772733584 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12175576879/original/9h6NemO3ESnGVp8CFV5Izek38g2jb2pi9w.png?1772733615 | alt: ]
NOTE: Members must be active in order to be able to post a comment. If a not active member attempts to comment a post an error message will display letting them know their account must be active:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12106666799/original/cFwrbnjy_P85lBrMl1h1OQg6MCiVJnI_CA.png?1647987201 | alt: ]

## "Follow" Comments Notifications
Users will have 3 options to receive an email notification:

## Any New Comments
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144792048/original/XqqjRKx2Aeza4bIVcebwy4M6vtJ27FmDQg.png?1718297136 | alt: ]

## Only Replies to My Comments
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144792049/original/29cjyWcYkiVOmP84GMORtNh653nCsYhfCA.png?1718297143 | alt: ]

## Cancel - Stop Following Comments
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144792052/original/09i-h9VwYT67Meq-5Hx8mYauEI4uOyAFDQ.png?1718297149 | alt: ]
Having the " Follow Post " button will be the indication that any user wants to receive notifications when comments are left on a specific post.
The System Email that is sent out is found in:
Emails
Click on Email Templates
Search for post-comment-reply-notification
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144792835/original/g5baXhFOE2ZUQxkTg0dNHcIeyZwXhV0xPg.png?1718297800 | alt: ]
More information: How to Edit Email Templates
